traits.name: Unbroken Memory
traits.description: Neither Chancery audit-smoke nor Mist-Weir fog can blur the faces and names you refuse to surrender.
traits.perks: +2 bonus on Mythology & Lore and Investigation checks.

traits.name: Steady Under Fog
traits.description: You read shifting lantern-halos across the salt-flats as clearly as sunlit roads.
traits.perks: +2 bonus on Perception and Tracking checks.

traits.name: Toll-Hardened
traits.description: Years watching Chancery collectors squeeze coin from dust taught you every loophole in a contract.
traits.perks: +2 bonus on Persuasion checks and +2 Maximum Morale.

traits.name: Cinder-Tempered Nerve
traits.description: Your lungs and sinews hardened beside roaring ash-kilns where weaker souls falter.
traits.perks: +5 Maximum Health and +2 bonus on Athletics & Survival checks.

traits.name: Unstamped Shadow
traits.description: Bailiff patrols pass inches from your cloak without ever catching your silhouette in their lamp-beams.
traits.perks: +2 bonus on Stealth and Sleight of Hand checks.

traits.name: Bell-Tuned Spirit
traits.description: Your heartbeat resonates with the older pre-Toll chimes of the Threshold, steadying body and mind.
traits.perks: +2 Maximum Morale, +2 Standing with The Quiet Oar, and +2 Medicine checks.
